ns_curator.text: The Leventis is the museum of Nicosia itself: the city from its first villages to today. Copper Age figures, Lusignan pottery, Ottoman costumes, British stamps.
The island's name and copper go back a long way together: the Latin word for copper comes from 'Cyprus'. Bronze Age Cyprus shipped copper all round the eastern Mediterranean.
Lusignan, Venetian, Ottoman, British, and now this. Every ruler left a building and took a bit of the view. The cats stayed throughout.

ns_visitor.text: My grandmother's wedding dress is in that case. She'd be furious. She said it never fitted.
